Laura Edwards should link here
Laura F. Edwards is a professor of history and author in the United States. She has written five books. A legal historian, the five books she has written focus on law gender and race in the Ynited States during the 19th century.
She was a professor at Duke University before joining the faculty at Princeton University.
In 2026 she was president of the Southern Historical Society.
